summary: codeflare-operator (also known as: CodeFlare operator) is a Kubernetes component. managing 1 CRD(s): AppWrapper. deploying 2 workload(s) (manager, manager) with 2 container(s). watching 8 resource type(s). exposing 1 service(s) on ports: 443. with 6 webhook(s) (3 validating, 3 mutating). with 36 operator config constants (2 image references). with 2 ingress route(s). integrates with management relationship via labels/annotations. deploys OAuth proxy sidecar for authentication. kustomize overlays: config/crd/appwrapper, config/crd, config/default, config/manager, config/manifests, config/odh-operator, config/prometheus, config/rbac, config/scorecard, config/webhook. references components: kuberay (import).
repository_description: The CodeFlare-Operator has embedded two controllers, a RayCluster controller which creates resources including secrets, ingress, routes, service, serviceaccounts, clusterrolebinding resources; all needed for the RayClusters created to work as expected.
